one_line: A skilled Maratha-era silk and cotton weaver working between Paithan–Yeola and Maheshwar’s loom towns.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s, lean but sturdy from physical loom work
appearance.face: oval face, medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, strong brows, a soft jawline with slight callus marks on fingers visible when close-up; default expression calm and focused with a gentle, observant gaze.
appearance.hair: thick black hair parted in the middle, pulled back into a low bun at the nape and wrapped tightly in a narrow off-white cotton headscarf (pagadi-style strip) tied at the back, with a few short stray strands near the temples.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate Deccan artisan attire: an ankle-length, unstitched Paithani-style sari in rich deep marigold-yellow silk with a broad maroon pallu and gold zari peacock motifs at the borders, draped in a practical Marathi nauvari style (tightly pleated, allowing leg movement) but fully modest, worn over a fitted half-sleeve cotton blouse in dark bottle-green; a thin, pale cream cotton angarkha-style wrap is sometimes folded over one shoulder like a working shawl; simple silver toe rings, a pair of small gold studs in the ears, a single thin green glass bangle on each wrist, and a small red bindi on the forehead; feet in plain brown leather Kolhapuri-style sandals.
appearance.signature: A sturdy wooden pit loom frame with a partly woven sari showing Paithani-style peacock tapestry at one end and a Maheshwari-style reversible striped border at the other, with her right hand always resting lightly on the shuttle.

ref_desc: A medium-brown oval-faced young weaver with black hair in a low bun wrapped in an off-white headscarf, wearing a deep marigold-yellow Paithani-style sari with maroon zari peacock borders, bottle-green blouse, simple silver jewellery, always beside a wooden pit loom with a mixed Paithani–Maheshwari sari and holding its shuttle.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a Maratha-era Indian weaver: a medium-brown oval-faced young adult with calm, focused eyes, black hair parted in the middle and pulled into a low bun wrapped in a narrow off-white cotton headscarf tied at the back, a few loose strands near her temples. She wears an ankle-length deep marigold-yellow silk Paithani-style sari, modestly draped in a Marathi nauvari style that still fully covers her torso and legs, with broad maroon borders and zari peacock motifs along the edges and pallu; under it is a fitted half-sleeve bottle-green cotton blouse. Over one shoulder, show a folded pale cream cotton angarkha-style wrap like a working shawl. Add small gold stud earrings, a thin pair of green glass bangles, simple silver toe rings, a small red bindi, and plain brown leather Kolhapuri-style sandals. Place her beside a detailed wooden pit loom frame, with a partly woven sari on it that clearly shows Paithani-style peacock tapestry at one end and Maheshwari-style reversible striped borders at the other, her right hand resting lightly on the shuttle as her key prop. Use a palette dominated by deep marigold-yellow, maroon, bottle green, cream and warm brown, and show front, side and back views to make the hairstyle, sari drape, jewellery and loom prop clear for consistent redrawing.
